item.title: ECB’s Escriva expects interest rates to remain steady
item.description: European Central Bank policymaker Jose Luis Escriva said he expects interest rates to remain steady in the foreseeable future, citing inflation expectations that are anchored around the institution’s 2% target. Escriva made these comments during an interview with Spanish radio station Cadena SER on Friday. Source: Investing.com
